clips.title: The story
paras: Hive'Ashi is a sprawling silithid colony dominating the northern sands of Silithus. As one of three major insectoid hives in the region, its creeping tunnels and towering mounds churn with countless hostile workers, defenders, and stingers.

Situated in northern Silithus, Hive'Ashi serves as a prime hive-complex for the re-emerging silithid swarms. Its chitinous spires carve out a distinct territory among the dunes, sending foraging workers and venomous defenders south and east toward the Swarming Pillar. Anyone seeking to understand the strange, coordinated intelligence stirring within the desert wastes inevitably finds their path leading directly into the dangerous, buzzing tunnels beneath these mounds.

Cenarion scouts stationed across Silithus monitor Hive'Ashi closely, commissioning brave combatants to thin its ranks and retrieve reconnaissance reports from deep within the colony. The glyphs and coordinated behavior documented within Ashi suggest that these mindless-looking insects share an eerie, singular will. As their numbers swell, the hive threatens to spill beyond northern Silithus entirely, making the eradication of its brood a top priority for those watching the southern borders.
